jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a)(2)(C) inventory: the Essex Westford Educational Community Unified Union Supervisory District's district is the Essex Westford School District (member communities: Town of Essex, City of Essex Junction, Westford).
Essex Westford School District (official district website).

sources.note: Essex Westford School District 'Meet the School Board' page (official): 'EWSD has 10 elected School Board members representing Essex Town, Essex Junction, and Westford... School Directors are elected by voters in the communities they represent. Board seats have three-year terms.' The allocation (Essex Town 4, Essex Junction 4, Westford 2) is from the Articles of Agreement (Art. 9) approved November 3, 2015 and is confirmed in every annual-meeting warning 2022-2026; no consolidated current articles document was located (the 2015 study-committee text controls, corroborated in current operation). Westford's two directors carry a 0.5 weighted board vote each under Art. 9; its current application is undocumented post-2022.

Essex Westford official results article, April 15, 2026: Scott Brown and Dawn Irwin (Essex Junction), Jemima Talbot (Essex Town) and Marilyn McConnell (Westford) elected April 14, 2026 -- matching the board page's term-end 2029 group. The April 9, 2025 results article likewise matches the 2028 group (Carpenter, Taylor, Verasamy). The same April 2026 vote moved the annual meeting to March from 2027; the board page's April term-end labels are minted as published.

Erin Kennedy Knox (Essex Junction) sat on the board through the November 18, 2025 minutes on a term expiring April 2026; she is not among the April 14, 2026 winners and not on the current board page (her seat passed to Dawn Irwin). Whether she lost or did not seek re-election is not stated. Her membership is ended in 2026.

Andre Roy (Westford) sat on the board through the December 15, 2025 committee minutes on a term expiring April 2026; he is not among the April 14, 2026 winners and not on the current board page (his seat passed to Marilyn McConnell). Whether he lost or did not seek re-election is not stated. His membership is ended in 2026.
